description: Linear statistical models are used to study the way a response variable depends on an unknown, linear combination of explanatory and/or classification variables. This course focuses on the theory of linear models and the topics include: linear regression model, general linear model, prediction problems, sensitivity analysis, analysis of incomplete data, robust regression, multiple comparisons, introduction to generalised linear models. This course is targeted at students who are interested in Statistics and are able to meet the prerequisite.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed ST3131 at a grade of at least D )
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) ST3131:D)
title: Linear Models
